remarks: Sun-filled 2BR/2BA apartment with stunning views of downtown Stamford. This beautifully updated unit features a modern kitchen with white cabinetry, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar that opens to the living/dining area. Enjoy hardwood flooring throughout, recessed lighting, and a large master bedroom with a huge walk-in closet. Both full bathrooms are updated, and the unit includes an in-unit washer/dryer for added convenience. Rent includes 2 garage parking spots! The Windemere offers excellent amenities including a gym, secured entry, patio with BBQs, and guest parking. Perfectly located within walking distance to all that Stamford has to offer!
